question: Approve a local saved-evidence audit and one reader evaluation before considering new overall-goal trials?

artifacts.summary: Recommend audit saved evidence and conduct one reader evaluation rather than build a feature or run new trials. Reconcile baseline identity first: existing records cover different scopes and cannot be pooled into a whole-skill success claim. Measure whether added evidence resolves a real uncertainty or justifies narrowing a named verification step. Supported, unsupported and inconclusive are valid outcomes. No product changes, new UI, paid runs or private evidence publication authorized.
